latestVersion.changelog:
OpenClaw Memory Master v4.3.0 introduces a major upgrade with a modular, smart memory curation system and extensive new features.

- Added 6 core TypeScript modules: SmartMemoryCurator, AutoClassifier, AutoTagger, DeduplicationEngine, ImportanceScorer, RelationDiscoverer.
- New enterprise-level features: real-time performance monitoring, plugin architecture, and enhanced emotion/tagging capabilities.
- Brand new README and developer documentation describing installation, quick start, API usage, configuration, and core module details.
- Significantly reorganized project structure for modularity and clarity.
- File structure shifted from /src to root-level .ts files for all core logic; legacy v4.2 docs and src files removed.
- Performance and feature details now extensively documented, including core algorithms for classification, tagging, deduplication, and scoring.
